notes.title: The Frogs will take you through a humorous renaissance artwork adventure
notes.content:
Making use of public domain renaissance artwork, The Frogs is an upcoming comedy point and click adventure. A demo is available and now they're on Kickstarter.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2022/06/the-frogs-will-take-you-through-a-humorous-renaissance-artwork-adventure

notes.title: The KICKSTARTER is Now LIVE!
notes.content:

notes.title: The Frogs Demo Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40227493/e5c53d6f3ac2d438440bfa208bcf3e593fe54980.png[/img]Hello! I've just pushed through an update with extensive testing which means there will be plenty of bugs and typos for you all to find, I'm sure. Here's what's new!

- Menus got a bit of an overhaul. They look better and, hopefully, work better.
- Added an Options menu with a music volume slider and subtitle size option.
- Inventory window now closes when you select an item.
- You can left and right click on items in your inventory to examine them.
- Dialogue in various spots has been cleaned up a bit.
- Fixed some weirdness in how a few interactions worked.
- Various typos and mistargeted dialogue have been cleaned up.

I hope you enjoy, and please don't hesitate to reach out if you have issues! I can be slow to respond sometimes, but I really do appreciate it!

notes.title: Go on an adventure through Renaissance art in The Frogs, try out the demo
notes.content:
Done in a similar amusing way to The Procession to Calvary (different developer), the upcoming point and click adventure The Frogs puts you into Renaissance art based on a play from Aristophanes.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2021/04/go-on-an-adventure-through-renaissance-art-in-the-frogs-try-out-the-demo
